sections.text: A locked gate stands at the edge of the forest. A narrow trail leads to an old cottage, while a dark tunnel runs under the gate.

options.description: Follow the trail to the cottage

consequence.text: The tunnel collapses before you can escape.

sections.text: At the cottage, a keeper offers you a brass key. Thorn bushes cover the way back.

options.description: Take the key and cross the thorn bushes

consequence.text: The thorns scratch your arms, but you reach the gate.

options.description: Rest before returning to the gate

consequence.text: A warm meal restores your strength.

sections.text: You leave the cottage with the key and find a safe path to the gate.
Your journey ends in the collapsed tunnel.
The brass key turns in the lock. The gate opens, and you step safely into the village.
